title: Returned-Payment Fees Counted on a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Credit and Collections policy — which earlier returned-payment fees count when a Patient Payment Plan draft comes back**

The returned-payment fees already booked on a Patient Payment Plan are counted over a window set by the plan's record: for a plan signed at least 12 whole months before the handling date with no installment recorded as missed within the last 12 months, only the returned-payment fees on installments within the last 6 months are counted; for a plan signed at least 12 whole months before the handling date with an installment recorded as missed within the last 12 months, those on installments within the last 12 months are counted; for any other plan every returned-payment fee in the plan's life is counted.

Within this charge, an entry lies within the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the handling date, installments and fees being placed by the installment's due date and other entries by the day they were recorded. A plan's age is measured in whole calendar months from the date the agreement was signed to the handling date.

## Window by plan record

| Signed at least 12 whole months before the handling date | Installment recorded as missed within the last 12 months | Returned-payment fees counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | None | Those on installments due within the last 6 months |
| Yes | One or more | Those on installments due within the last 12 months |
| No | Either | Every returned-payment fee of the plan's life |

## Hypothetical cases (handling date 2026-10-10)

1. Signed 2024-08-01, no missed installment since 2025-10-11, returned-payment fees on installments due 2025-12-15 and 2026-06-15. Only the fee on 2026-06-15 (3 whole months before) lies within the last 6 months; the count is 1.
2. The same plan with an installment recorded as missed that was due 2026-02-15: the 12-month window applies, and both fees are counted, giving 2.
3. Signed 2026-01-05 (9 whole months before): every returned-payment fee of the plan's life is counted.
4. Boundary of the 6-month window: a fee on an installment due 2026-04-11 is within it (5 whole months); one due 2026-04-10 is not (6 whole months).
